binding_rule: Direct contracts are required here for swarm functions that classify collisions, compose candidate findings, or call external model providers. Generated contracts remain permitted for mechanical helpers.

contracts.authority_requirement: Synthesis may normalize, preserve provenance and exact-deduplicate candidates only. It may not establish truth, severity, admission, canonical promotion, merge authority or majority-vote acceptance.
contracts.result_algebra: CANDIDATES_ONLY_NOT_ADMITTED; every surviving candidate is forced to NEEDS_CROSS_REFERENCE.
contracts.resource_and_termination_bounds: Finite traversal over supplied results/findings; exact-hash deduplication only.

contracts.authority_requirement: Comparison grants no integration or merge authority; semantic overlap can only increase review requirements.
contracts.result_algebra: POTENTIAL_COLLISION | NO_OVERLAP with explicit reasons and required-receipt bit.
contracts.resource_and_termination_bounds: Finite set/path comparisons over supplied intents.

contracts.authority_requirement: PASS means only that declared supplied intents satisfy this guard. Missing/stale/undeclared work cannot be inferred away and the guard grants no merge/canonical authority.
contracts.result_algebra: PASS | REQUIRES_INTEGRATION_RECEIPT | BLOCKED with explicit uncertainty.
contracts.resource_and_termination_bounds: Finite over supplied intents and one optional receipt.

contracts.authority_requirement: External model output is PROPOSALS_ONLY and never receives merge, deployment, canonical-promotion or private-source authority.
contracts.result_algebra: RunResult[OK|ERROR] preserving returned model, usage, annotations and error text.
contracts.resource_and_termination_bounds: One provider call with bounded timeout and configured max tokens.
